# short-form-captions

> Word timestamps (Whisper JSON, WhisperX, whisper.cpp full JSON, or any array of words with start and end) to SRT, WebVTT or
> ASS captions for vertical (9:16) video; the ASS is placed inside the area TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Facebook
> Reels all leave clear in their published 9:16 ad safe zones, with word-by-word highlighting. Also a checker for SRT and WebVTT
> files (characters a second, words a minute, characters a line, lines, duration, gaps) against Netflix's and the BBC's
> published subtitle guidelines, each rule quoted with its source. A command line tool and a JavaScript module for Node 18+, no
> dependencies. Code MIT; data CC BY 4.0 except the quoted guideline text, which belongs to its publishers.

Short answers:
- Whisper word timestamps to SRT: npx github:viewgum/short-form-captions words words.json > captions.srt
- Word-by-word highlighted captions inside the safe zone: npx github:viewgum/short-form-captions words words.json --to ass --style highlight --out captions.ass, then ffmpeg -i video.mp4 -vf "ass=captions.ass" -c:a copy out.mp4
- Check reading speed and line length: npx github:viewgum/short-form-captions check captions.srt --profile netflix (42 characters a line, 2 lines, 20 characters a second, 5/6 s to 7 s, 2 frames between cues, from Netflix's English (USA) SDH guide, its General Requirements and its Subtitle Timing Guidelines)

- [README](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-captions/blob/main/README.md): commands, input shapes, positions, styles, profiles
- [data/guidelines.json](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-captions/blob/main/data/guidelines.json): every rule with the guideline's words, section and date read
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-captions/blob/main/skills/short-form-captions/SKILL.md): npx skills add viewgum/short-form-captions

## Related
